Booked it for the weekend.

Now I'm wondering if I can stay forever.

Tucked away just off the coast,
Villa Nivara has everything your mind's been craving,
a private pool that catches golden hour just right,
cosy corners that beg for books and naps,
mornings with no agenda,
and silence that feels like care.
There's WiFi if you need it,
but you'll probably forget to check.

This isn't just a getaway.
It's a soft reset.
It's the space to breathe between life's noise.
And honestly? You'll want to come back before you've even left.
